Package common.hardware.camera

package common.hardware.camera
Vision. DynamicCamera reads AprilTags through PhotonVision and works out where the robot is, so the drivetrain can correct its odometry. Odometry from the wheels slowly drifts as they slip; seeing a tag whose position on the field is known pulls the estimate back to the truth.

In simulation, the cameras see simulated tags, so vision code can be tested without a robot.
